baseline.note: iteration-budget deterministic; B is a pinned constant, machine-independent

h01.ctt.b_remeasured: Measured on transformed instances in the same judging resource envelope as production submit.sh: isolated execution environment, 1C/8G; the judging runner parallelizes internally with JUDGE_JOBS=cpu_count and pins each instance to 1 core with taskset. The judging pipeline is unchanged (/tests/test.sh, fan-out by INSTANCE_SHARD, hard limit of 240s per instance). The shipped baseline in environment/app is unchanged (excluding the same packaging as submit).
h01.ctt.b_source: Packaged baseline measurement on the transformed input (1C/8G).
